tasks.subject: Task 2b: Fix nested-constructor binder bug (buildSubPats) for full nested support
tasks.description:
Fix pre-existing bug: binders inside a nested constructor sub-pattern dropped on the single-Alt path. buildSubPats catch-all (Elaborate.hs ~721-728) pre-forces the body via `altBody <- wraps inner; ... (pure altBody)` before elabPat establishes p's binders -> UnboundVar. Fix: `alt <- elabPat tk (AVar n) p (wraps inner)` (pass continuation unforced). Delivers plain nested (Some (Some n)) AND nested as-patterns (Some (n as m)). Also clean the stale Infer.hs APAs comment.
